title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.16116v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Developing and evaluating e-commerce web agents requires environments that preserve meaningful task structure while enabling controllable, reproducible, and scalable scientific comparison. Existing methods force a tradeoff: live storefronts provide realism but are non-stationary, difficult to inspect, and irreproducible, while hand-built sandbox benchmarks provide control but cover only a narrow range of layouts, catalogs, policies, and interaction patterns. We argue that the core bottleneck is methodological: the field lacks a scalable way to construct evaluation settings that are simultaneously realistic, diverse, controllable, inspectable, and reproducible. translated_title: ShopGym：一个用于电子商务网络智能体真实仿真与可扩展基准测试的集成框架
translated_abstract: 开发和评估电子商务网络智能体需要既能保留有意义的任务结构、又能支持可控、可复现且可扩展的科学比较的环境。现有方法迫使我们做出权衡：真实在线商店提供了真实性，但具有非静态性、难以检查和不可复现的问题；而手工构建的沙盒基准虽然提供了控制能力，却仅涵盖有限的布局、商品目录、政策和交互模式。我们认为核心瓶颈在于方法论层面：该领域缺乏一种可扩展的方式来构建同时具备真实性、多样性、可控性、可检查性和可复现性的评估环境。我们提出了ShopGym，一个用于电子商务网络智能体真实仿真与可扩展基准测试的集成框架。其仿真层ShopArena通过匿名化的商店规范和分阶段的验证流程，将真实的种子商店转换为独立完整的沙盒商店（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: ShopGym提出了一种集成框架，通过将真实在线商店转化为匿名化、可复现的沙盒仿真环境，解决了电子商务网络智能体评估中真实性与可控性、可扩展性难以兼顾的方法论瓶颈。
en_tdlr: ShopGym introduces an integrated framework that converts live seed storefronts into anonymized, self-contained, reproducible sandbox simulations, addressing the methodological bottleneck of achieving realism, diversity, controllability, and scalability simultaneously in e-commerce web agent benchmarking.
